source.attribution: See NOTICE.md in the parent directory.

action_items.text: Speaker_3 (industrial designer) will work on the actual working design of the remote before the next meeting.
action_items.quote: as the industrial designer, you're gonna be working on you know the actual working design of it

action_items.text: Speaker_4 (user interface) will work on the technical functions, i.e. what the remote will actually do, before the next meeting.
action_items.quote: for user interface, technical functions, I guess that's you know like what we've been talking about, what it'll actually do.

action_items.text: Speaker_2 (marketing) will think about the requirements the remote has to fulfil before the next meeting.
action_items.quote: marketing executive, you'll be just thinking about what it actually what, you know, what requirements it has to has to fulfil

notes: Kick-off meeting with essentially no firm decisions; the only clear commitments are the three role-based tasks the project manager assigns in the wrap-up. I left out the floated ideas (combine many devices in one remote, extra functions, find-my-remote beep, touch screen) since none were explicitly settled, the next-meeting time, and the emailed instructions (no one commits to a task).
